propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui beatum Joannem, Confessorem tuum, ad cultum sacrorum Cordium
Jesu et Mariae rite promovendum, mirabiliter inflammasti, et per eum novas
in Ecclesia tua familias congregare voluisti: praesta, quaesumus; ut,
cujus pia merita veneramur, virtutum quoque instruamur exemplis. Per
eundem Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et
regnat in unitate.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Begins on leaf n1158, printed p. 1166, under `Prayer` in the Mass headed `St. John Eudes, Confessor`, and finishes on leaf n1159, printed p. 1167; both leaves were opened. The Latin is the 1962 slot's prayer word for word, differing only in pointing and the witness's abbreviated conclusion `Per eumdem Dominum`.
translations.source_label: The New Roman Missal in Latin and English, revised edition, by F. X. Lasance and Francis Augustine Walsh (New York: Benziger Brothers, 1945), ca. 1955-56 printing (Internet Archive delivery locator fr-lasance-missal-1937; locator mislabelled)
translations.text: O God, Who, to rightly promote the worship of the Sacred Hearts of Jesus and Mary, hast wonderfully inflamed blessed John Thy confessor, and through him hast willed to assemble new families in Thy Church; grant, we beseech Thee, that we may both venerate his pious merits and be edified by the examples of his virtues. Through the same.
